notes.title: Lost Lullabies v1.3 Update
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45047263/553c7f1d04d18870fd23e236ec85f894d82b7b3c.png"]

Lost Lullabies v1.3 Update



Patch Notes

         This update adds a new Nightmare Difficulty for those looking for a tougher challenge, along with controller support and a few small improvements to minigames.



Nightmare Difficulty

A new difficulty mode for elite ghost hunters, pushing your skills and nerves to the limit.

One evidence type will be hidden

No setup time before the first hunt

Hunts last longer, and each kill extends the hunt duration

Coke restores significantly less sanity

Fuse box starts off by default

Almost no hiding spots in any location

Shady Dealer's Shop will not refresh its stock



Controller Support

Full controller support is now available.



Changes & Tweaks

In the Alex minigame, when the radio emits a sound, the board’s numbers now light up

The requirement to access the Expel Evil phase is reduced from 3 to 2 correctly identified ghosts

Clock interactions in the Margareth minigame now have visual feedback



Join our Discord to share any thoughts or feedback.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45047263/d2d5d2e11ecd0e6cd29998c0168c97ddfe479719.png"]

notes.title: Lost Lullabies v1.1 Update
notes.notes:
Patch Notes

Performance Improvements:

Optimized texture sizes and materials.
Various optimization tweaks to ensure the game runs smoothly on all devices. We hope this improves the experience for everyone.

Bug Fixes:

Fixed an issue with Chris' hair.
Video camera rendering improved to better recognize ghost orbs.
Fixed an issue preventing Robert minigame kills.
Fixed a bug where telephones and radios could be heard in unintended locations.
Fixed cross item issues.

Graphics & Settings:

Added Shadow Distance option to Graphics Settings.
Added Screen Space Ambient Occlusion quality setting.
Brightness adjustments: The highest value is now more visible (not recommended).
FPS capping added to the lowest quality settings to prevent drops on low-end devices.

Gameplay & Controls:

Added X-Y Invert option to Controller Settings.
Added Camera Shake option to Gameplay Settings.
Ghost no longer continues hunting after the first kill on Normal difficulty.
Increased the chance of Spirit Box responses.
Item prices adjusted.

Thank you for your continued support and feedback! Your input helps us improve the game with every update. If you have any suggestions, bug reports, or just want to chat with the community, join us on Discord! We’d love to hear your thoughts and experiences. See you in the game!

notes.title: Lost Lullabies v1.0 Update
notes.notes:
Hello Ghost Hunters,
Here are the latest changes in this patch:

 Added in-game keybind customization.
 Increased the visibility duration of Ghost Spheres.
 Grace Period increased by 2 seconds across all difficulties.
 Increased the frequency of ghosts providing evidence.
 Reduced the frequency of ghosts initiating hunts.
 Ghost fingerprints now last longer (Normal and Hard modes only).
 Increased the detection range of the EMF.
 Reduced the maximum speed ghosts can reach.
 Stamina regeneration time reduced from 5 seconds to 4 seconds.
 Reduced the sanity drain effect of the Glimmer Stone.
 The prices of items have been reduced.
 Yurei's sanity drain rate has been increased.

Thank you for your support. Please continue to share your feedback on Discord.
The Lost Lullabies Team

notes.title: Lost Lullabies Patch 0.051124
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Here’s our latest update with new features, bug fixes, and improvements to make your gameplay experience even better. Thank you all for your feedback!

Patch Notes:


 Fixed issue with the music box locking other players' hands.
 Fixed issue with the "yes" button not working at the end of mini-games.
 Dashboard adjusted.
 Fixed issue where the ghost would not end the hunt.
 Fixed issue where the ghost would get stuck during the hunt.
 Fixed issue where the ghost would get stuck on dead players.
 Fixed issue allowing players to obtain the same item twice from the Shady Dealer.
 Added new voice lines to the Dealer.
 Fixed mimic animations.
 Fixed issue preventing mimics from spawning.
 Fixed issue where the Dealer would not appear after a hunt.
 Updated some in-game text.
 Fixed issue where the Mysterious Box light would stay on.
 Fixed issue where Sanity would not display.
 Fixed issue where the camera would float in the air.
 Fixed issue where the tripod could not be picked up from the ground.
 Adjusted hiding spots.
 Reduced ghost's kill range.
 Fixed issue where the game would not end if all players were dead.
 Fixed issue preventing the game from starting after a player is kicked.
 Added new options to the settings.
 Adjusted microphone settings.
 Improved solutions for server and connection issues.
 Optimized the game for better performance.
 Adjusted master volume settings.
 Added new questions to the Spirit Box.
 Salt and Sani-Pen hand animations has been fixed.


Thank you for playing and supporting us!

notes.title: Lost Lullabies Patch 0.071024 (Hotfix)
notes.notes:
Patch  0.071024 

Hello everyone!
 
We’re thrilled to announce that our game was one of the most-played demos during the Next Fest! Alongside this success, we’ve made significant improvements regarding the issue of disconnecting from the server. We believe that most of the problems have been resolved. If you encounter any issues, please feel free to provide us with your feedbacks. Happy gaming!

Patch Notes

 Fixed an issue where items would get stuck and constantly make noise.
 Fixed an issue where items obtained from the Mysterious Chest were not visible in   multiplayer.
 Fixed an issue where in-game sounds and radio communications were incorrectly adjusted.
 Fixed an issue where the master volume did not function in the main menu.
 Minor UI fixes have been made.
 Now, the room owner can kick other players!
 The difficulty of the Exorcism of Emma has been balanced.
 Benchmark scene has been added.

notes.title: Lost Lullabies Patch 0.031024 (Hotfix)
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! We hope you're all enjoying Next Fest. Thank you for playing our game and providing your feedback. We’re aware of the issues you've reported and have made several fixes to address them.

Patch Notes


 We have fixed the bug that caused the game to randomly assign you to regions.
 We have added a button in the main menu where you can select your region.


Remember, in order to play with your friends, you need to select the same region. Thank you all for your support!

notes.title: Lost Lullabies Patch 0.021024 (Hotfix)
notes.notes:
Patch Notes:


 An online status has been added to the main menu. If the internet is lost, the status in the top right changes to offline, and a reconnect button appears.
 If you create a room while you are offline, a reconnect warning has been added.
 The issue with the password not being hidden in the lobby has been resolved.
 Errors in the save system have been fixed.
 The bug causing the feedback panel to get stuck has been fixed.
 Panels to be displayed in connection errors have been added.
 Minor UI bugs have been fixed.
 The issue of being unable to exit the Wrong Password screen has been resolved.
 The bug causing the game to drop when placing the G.R.I.D Projector has been fixed.
 Right-clicking has been added to place deployable items.
 The credits screen has been fixed.
 The bug causing incorrect sounds in the Exorcism section has been resolved.
 Optimizations have been made in the server connection process.


Please ensure that you are using the latest version of the game for the best experience.
